capability_ladder.name: No useful user-controlled action
capability_ladder.rule: Presence, constants, or unreachable helpers without a closed useful action.

capability_ladder.name: Useful local UI only
capability_ladder.rule: A stock application can render or manipulate its own local UI without a cross-component effect.

capability_ladder.name: Constrained application-defined action/output
capability_ladder.rule: The application performs a fixed-schema, fixed-destination, or otherwise application-defined output.

capability_ladder.name: Typed stock-service invocation
capability_ladder.rule: A recovered caller reaches a typed interface in another stock application or platform service.

capability_ladder.name: Generalized stock-signed dispatcher/extensibility
capability_ladder.rule: User or external data controls a selector or payload entering a generalized dispatcher over existing stock behavior.

capability_ladder.name: General-purpose execution
capability_ladder.rule: Controllable input produces arbitrary code/process/script execution or equivalent behavior.

ceiling.highest_conditional_kim19_candidate: The same typed Level-3 paths after target installation, grants, services, and connectivity gates are satisfied.
ceiling.highest_proved_candidate: Typed stock-service invocation through Yelp phone/navigation, Apps/AppManager/AMS, VSB/IXC, MTS, and related fixed stock contracts.
ceiling.larger_objective: No path materially extends functionality beyond the behavior designed into existing stock applications; no new resident UI/runtime or arbitrary-code capability results.
ceiling.level_4_kim19_result: No KIM19 path lets user/external data control a generalized dispatcher beyond finite configured stock contracts.
ceiling.level_5_result: No general-purpose execution path is proved or conditionally justified for KIM19.

decision.label: INFERRED
decision.reason: All plausible level-changing recovered-artifact families are closed or bounded. Remaining gates are mutable target installation, authorization, services, connectivity, media, and historical state that static artifacts cannot resolve.
decision.recommended_next_action: Run A1, then B1 only if Yelp is visible; record the first stable state and stop.
decision.statement: Static research is exhausted; one or more specific target observations are now the correct next step.
